verses.original: אָ֚נָה הָלַ֣ךְ דּוֹדֵ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים אָ֚נָה פָּנָ֣ה דוֹדֵ֔ךְ וּנְבַקְשֶׁ֖נּוּ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nāh hā·laḵ dō·w·ḏêḵ hay·yā·p̄āh ban·nā·šîm ’ā·nāh pā·nāh ḏō·w·ḏêḵ ū·nə·ḇaq·šen·nū ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Where has your beloved gone O most beautiful among women Which way has he turned We will seek him with you

verses.original: דּוֹדִי֙ יָרַ֣ד לְגַנּ֔וֹ לַעֲרוּג֖וֹת הַבֹּ֑שֶׂם לִרְעוֹת֙ בַּגַּנִּ֔ים וְלִלְקֹ֖ט שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dō·w·ḏî yā·raḏ lə·ḡan·nōw la·‘ă·rū·ḡō·wṯ hab·bō·śem lir·‘ō·wṯ bag·gan·nîm wə·lil·qōṭ šō·wō·šan·nîm
verses.literal: My beloved has gone down to his garden to the beds of spices to pasture his flock in the gardens and to gather lilies

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י לְדוֹדִי֙ וְדוֹדִ֣י לִ֔י הָרֹעֶ֖ה בַּשׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃ס
verses.literal: I belong to my beloved and he belongs to me he pastures his flock among the lilies

verses.original: יָפָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ רַעְיָתִי֙ כְּתִרְצָ֔ה נָאוָ֖ה כִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: yā·p̄āh ’at ra‘·yā·ṯî kə·ṯir·ṣāh nā·wāh kî·rū·šā·lim ’ă·yum·māh kan·niḏ·gā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: You are as beautiful my darling as Tirzah as lovely as Jerusalem as majestic as troops with banners

verses.original: הָסֵ֤בִּי עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ מִנֶּגְדִּ֔י שֶׁ֥הֵ֖ם הִרְהִיבֻ֑נִי שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּלְשׁ֖וּ מִן־ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hā·sêb·bî ‘ê·na·yiḵ min·neḡ·dî še·hêm hir·hî·ḇu·nî śa‘·rêḵ kə·‘ê·ḏer hā·‘iz·zîm šeg·gā·lə·šū min- hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Turn your eyes away from me for they have overcome me Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down from Gilead

verses.original: שִׁנַּ֙יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽרְחֵלִ֔ים שֶׁעָל֖וּ מִן־ הָרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šin·na·yiḵ kə·‘ê·ḏer hā·rə·ḥê·lîm še·‘ā·lū min- hā·raḥ·ṣāh šek·kul·lām maṯ·’î·mō·wṯ wə·šak·ku·lāh ’ên bā·hem
verses.literal: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing each has its twin and not one of them is lost
Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate

verses.original: שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הֵ֙מָּה֙ מְּלָכ֔וֹת וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים פִּֽילַגְשִׁ֑ים וַעֲלָמ֖וֹת אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šiš·šîm hêm·māh mə·lā·ḵō·wṯ ū·šə·mō·nîm pî·laḡ·šîm wa·‘ă·lā·mō·wṯ ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines and maidens without number

verses.original: אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ יוֹנָתִ֣י תַמָּתִ֔י אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ לְאִמָּ֔הּ בָּרָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְיֽוֹלַדְתָּ֑הּ רָא֤וּהָ בָנוֹת֙ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֔וּהָ מְלָכ֥וֹת וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וַֽיְהַלְלֽוּהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaṯ hî yō·w·nā·ṯî ṯam·mā·ṯî ’a·ḥaṯ hî lə·’im·māh bā·rāh hî lə·yō·w·laḏ·tāh rā·’ū·hā ḇā·nō·wṯ way·’aš·šə·rū·hā mə·lā·ḵō·wṯ ū·p̄î·laḡ·šîm way·hal·lū·hā
verses.literal: but my dove my perfect one . . . is unique the favorite . . . of the mother who bore her The maidens see her and call her blessed the queens and concubines sing her praises

verses.original: מִי־ זֹ֥את הַנִּשְׁקָפָ֖ה כְּמוֹ־ שָׁ֑חַר יָפָ֣ה כַלְּבָנָ֗ה בָּרָה֙ כַּֽחַמָּ֔ה אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: mî- zōṯ han·niš·qā·p̄āh kə·mōw- šā·ḥar yā·p̄āh ḵal·lə·ḇā·nāh bā·rāh ka·ḥam·māh ’ă·yum·māh kan·niḏ·gā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Who is this who shines like the dawn as fair as the moon as bright as the sun as majestic as the stars in procession

verses.original: אֶל־ גִּנַּ֤ת אֱגוֹז֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי לִרְא֖וֹת בְּאִבֵּ֣י הַנָּ֑חַל לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲפָֽרְחָ֣ה הַגֶּ֔פֶן הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- gin·naṯ ’ĕ·ḡō·wz yā·raḏ·tî lir·’ō·wṯ bə·’ib·bê han·nā·ḥal lir·’ō·wṯ hă·p̄ā·rə·ḥāh hag·ge·p̄en hê·nê·ṣū hā·rim·mō·nîm
verses.literal: I went down to the walnut grove to see the blossoms of the valley to see if the vines were budding or the pomegranates were in bloom

verses.original: לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי נַפְשִׁ֣י שָׂמַ֔תְנִי מַרְכְּב֖וֹת עַמִּי־ נָדִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: lō yā·ḏa‘·tî nap̄·šî śā·maṯ·nî mar·kə·ḇō·wṯ ‘am·mî- nā·ḏîḇ
verses.literal: Before I realized it my desire had set me among the royal chariots of my people

verses.original: שׁ֤וּבִי שׁ֙וּבִי֙ הַשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית שׁ֥וּבִי שׁ֖וּבִי וְנֶחֱזֶה־ בָּ֑ךְ מַֽה־ תֶּחֱזוּ֙ בַּשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית כִּמְחֹלַ֖ת הַֽמַּחֲנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḇî šū·ḇî haš·šū·lam·mîṯ šū·ḇî šū·ḇî wə·ne·ḥĕ·zeh- bāḵ mah- te·ḥĕ·zū baš·šū·lam·mîṯ kim·ḥō·laṯ ham·ma·ḥă·nā·yim
verses.literal: Come back come back O Shulammite Come back come back that we may gaze upon you Why do you look at the Shulammite as on the dance of Mahanaim
